The last hundred metres, where a facility becomes a fab.

Tool hook-up connects production equipment into the facility it sits in. Here is what the work involves, step by step.

Call PCU & TTI when
Your fab is running and new tools are coming in, or the gas, chemical, water or exhaust systems need to grow.

Representation
6
services connected to every tool
4
phases, from facilitization to commissioning

sector: semiconductor, front end to back end
What PCU & TTI is.

Total Tool Installation connects production equipment fully and precisely into the facility it sits in. IAQ designs, installs and commissions the process critical utilities, then brings each of them to the tool.

Why owners choose it.
It is the critical path

Hook-up is the last work before production, so the whole programme converges on it. Every day held to schedule is a day of output on the line.

The room is already live

This work happens inside a classified cleanroom that is finished and certified. Holding that classification while the tool goes in is the skill.

Semiconductor, front to back

Front end, advanced packaging and back end fabs. The sector where the tool is the investment and the facility exists to serve it.

One route from base build

The same company that built the facility connects the tools into it, so the last step stays inside one team.

Bought on its own

It is a standalone service, run on the EPC or EPCM model, on a base facility built by IAQ or by others.

Process critical utilities, run as one system.

Specialty gases, chemicals, ultrapure water and exhaust, designed, installed and commissioned as one system. They are what the production tool actually consumes.

01
Define the demand
What each production tool consumes: gas purity and flow, chemical volumes, ultrapure water quality, exhaust duty. The demand schedule is set from the tool list, tool by tool.
02
Design the distribution
Routing, materials and redundancy for each utility, sized against the demand schedule. The expansion case is allowed for at the outset.
03
Install to purity standards
Orbital welding, cleanliness protocols and materials handling appropriate to each service. Purity is built in at installation rather than recovered afterwards.
04
Test, purge and verify
Pressure testing, purging and purity verification service by service, with documentation issued against each one.
05
Commission against the tool
The utility is proven at the point of use, under the load the tool actually places on it.

01
Facilitize
Facilitization, before the tool arrives

Everything upstream of the tool’s connection point is built to the equipment maker’s facility requirements: the sub-fab and chase, the power, the structure and the room itself.

02
Rig in
Rig-in and move-in

The tool is uncrated in a de-trash airlock, so cardboard and wood stay outside the cleanroom.

03
Hook up
Hook-up proper

Each utility is tapped from the facility and connected into the tool, to its own standard.

04
Commission
Commissioning

Every connection is proven before production: leak tested, purged and dried down to specification, balanced, and tested for continuity and every safety trip.
